title: Survey of Institutions / Libraries for the development & Usage of IPC Library Resources.
bodyHtml:
Library division is conducting an online survey to enhance the library collection and services. Please spend your spare time to fill the questionnaire attached herewith the link provided.

Your response is valuable and will definitely help us to improve our resources for the benefit of the library users/ stakeholders.

In this regard, all the heads of the Institutions / Libraries are requested to kindly answer the questions by using the following link and submit it accordingly.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdVZ-SY_kFll2h_tBwMjckxKUgcb7WoC5NtXSb3fXSWntricA/viewform?usp=sf_link (opens in a new tab)

If you have any query, please send us email at: library-ipc@gov.in

Note: This questionnaire is part of the research/study. The information will be kept strictly confidential and entirely be used research purpose only.
